generated_note: Arabic for the 99 Names (catalogue N01–N99). Verified by two independent sources per scope-v1.md decision 3 (no unverified Arabic may receive an abjad number). SOURCE 1 is the canonical digital list from api.aladhan.com; its `name` field is what is stored here, verbatim — no Arabic was typed by hand. SOURCE 2 is the rendered page images of 99-Name-of-ALLAH.pdf (pypdfium2, scale 4.0, pages index 0–12), read visually because that PDF's text layer extracts in reversed display order. Cross-check rule: the two sources' consonantal skeletons were compared after passing every character through the project's own abjad engine (is_ignorable + NORMALIZE), so the comparison is exactly what the engine sees. All 99 matched, and all 99 abjad totals are identical whichever source's spelling is used. Abjad totals computed with library/tools/abjad.py (unmodified). This file adds data only; no existing file was modified.

sources.note: http://api.alquran.cloud/v1/asmaalhusna was tried first as instructed and returned HTTP 404 Not Found; api.aladhan.com is the endpoint that worked.

sources.method: pypdfium2 render at scale 4.0, cropped to the '#' / 'Name' / 'Transliteration' columns, then read by the agent. The PDF text layer was NOT used — it extracts in reversed display order.

sources.note: The transliteration already stored for each N-id extracted cleanly from the PDF and was used as a third check that number→name alignment is correct.
